status: exploratory; protocol saved before new outcomes, after existing checkpoint results were known; not external preregistration
model: StandardScaler then Ridge alpha=10, separate state/year/lead, annual fit; no hyperparameter selection
primary_scope_reason: Regional extra dates are available from 2022, giving two full training years only for 2024 onward. Earlier evaluations retain incomplete regional histories and are secondary. Only two primary annual clusters.
training: 730 days ending previous December 31; train targets <= that cutoff; origin is first unseen date; predict target origin+lead-1; causal input fill only, score recorded positive labels only
encoding: window: one scalar marking union of +/-3 days around anchors; 7: per-offset binary channels around the same anchors; never target encoding
primary_contrast: regional_window minus generic_window, event-balanced MASE on identical true regional windows; lower difference better; each state within year and each year weighted equally
secondary: all-day/non-event metrics; seven-channel contrast; zero padding; placebo and shifted date controls; do not choose a winner or change protocol on these outcomes

placebo.construction: One shift per year shared across all states. Move full regional anchor constellation by a multiple of seven within +/-42 days; exclude any overlap of placebo windows with true regional windows in any state. Random choice uses dates only. This is approximate seasonal and exact weekday matching, not exchangeability/causal evidence.

ledger: existing MAIN 2020-2025 and EXTRA 2022-2025; no added dates or amendment-certification claims
evaluation_cases: All original daily origins Jan 1 through Dec 18 per year, same for all arms; event membership fixed to unshifted regional windows for every arm
selection: none; no test-set tuning, no final untouched evaluation; no TSFM conclusions from Ridge controls
uncertainty: Report individual years and states. No p-values or bootstrap intervals with two primary years. No independence claim for nearby days/states.
deferred: past-only learned encodings requiring nested development selection
